spine.deviation_notes: What the player of the original would miss: (a) the literal slaughter -- engine has no primitive for consuming a proxy entity and reading its LIFE POOL into a spell's damage; the trigger-grammar + cycle-economy + doors model the rhythm and the trade, not the mechanism; (b) the SNAPSHOT (sacrificed-minion life locked into blade damage for their duration) has no carrier; (c) minion-life as an OFFENSIVE scaling stat inverts the trait lane (approximated in scaffold traits). The blade-orbit shell, the raise/sacrifice treadmill, and the sacrifice-for-power identity read through -- 'that build, worse', hence APPROX not GAPPED (R-M7 player test; b02 dark-pact precedent).

skills.delivery_notes: ethereal blades spin around the caster for 4s each, up to 10 active, repeatedly damaging enemies they pass through -- orbit is the NATIVE 26-type for exactly this (Wave-C R8-orbit; poe1-poison-bv/vaal-blade-vortex are its named engine exemplars). On each cast, Minion Pact SACRIFICES a random nearby damageable minion and adds physical damage equal to (2-2.8)% (up to ~5.4% scaled) of the sacrificed minion's life. Pure-physical -> element-neutral (physical rule); no ailment centrality attested

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: ENTITY-AS-CONSUMABLE-RESOURCE kit, post-cutoff (3.28 Minion Pact; probe conf capped <=0.5). NAMING CAVEAT carried per batch flag (c) + verify_ledger: the folk name 'Minion Pact Blade Vortex' is honestly UNATTESTED (identity verdict UNSUPPORTED, no anchor); the kit was promoted on CONFIRMED mechanics (the Minion Pact Support gem text is anchored verbatim) -- mechanics are mapped normally, the name is not source-warranted. Geometry is the batch's cleanest: orbit is native and engine-exemplified by BV itself. The sacrifice-snapshot mechanism is the recurring 'entity-on-the-field as a consumable resource pool' family (b02 STEWARD CONSOLIDATION FLAG: bladefall + dark-pact + b01 animate-weapon); per R-M7 precedent (b02 dark-pact stays APPROX/MAPPED) the identity is APPROXIMATED, not gapped: trigger grammar consume-only/on-cast-linked/resource-fill models cast-consumes-entity-fills-damage-budget at DEPTH-1; charge_stack=cycle carries the raise/spend treadmill; SACRIFICE_ASCENDANCY (b02 dark-pact door precedent) + RESOURCE_CONVERSION (minion-life -> damage). Docket candidate FILED adding this kit as 4th evidence to the recurring family (candidate side-files are not terminal-state drivers, R-M7). The SNAPSHOT nuance (damage locked at sacrifice time) is un-carried; noted.
